# /crav1-review-security

lane: cross-cutting | group: Keep the picture current | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.4.0 | prompts: 1
purpose: Ask whether the thing in front of you is secure, after architecture already exists (docs/system/ or a spec that already describes the design).
use_when: Architecture already exists
reads: Reads `docs/system/` or a spec that already describes the design, and the change when that is the target.
writes: Writes kept findings to `docs/system/security.md` or a Security section on that spec.
leaves alone: Leaves code, `plan.md`, and commits alone.
limits: spark, plan, and verify do not run it. `/crav1-review-architecture` may name it and does not run it.
flow:
- When architecture already exists, **`/crav1-review-security`** asks whether the thing in front of it is secure.
- It is not a mode of `/crav1-review-architecture`.
- Same command for the whole system (`docs/system/security.md`), one spec, or the change in front of you (a Security section on that spec).
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: /crav1-finalize-commit
first: `/crav1-review-security @docs/system/ Review the whole system. Do not write code. Do not plan.`
walkthrough: from-review-security.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.203.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-review-security.md
